method: Direct visual inspection of final captured English desktop and Arabic 390px mobile review screens.
observations: English desktop review contains all business fields, company/department and two location quantities with readable labels.
Arabic mobile review uses RTL, wraps mixed text, and displays all three quantity columns without horizontal scrolling.
Back, save draft and confirm submission controls fit the mobile viewport; sidebar collapses.
Replacement is shown as stable Employee ID; selecting its name does not expose the Employee profile.
limits: Visual review covers these synthetic review screens, not HR terminology sign-off or a full accessibility assessment.
Recorded availability is advisory and server validation remains authoritative.
